business.description: The Company did not undertake any operational business activities during the financial year ended March 31, 2026 and consequently did not generate any revenue from operations. The Company has not carried out any manufacturing operations since the closure of the plant in 1995.

auditor.name: M/s. Maark & Associates. (Chartered Accountants)
auditor.opinion: The Audit Report for the financial year ended March 31, 2026 does not contain any qualification, reservation, adverse remark or disclaimer.
qualifications_or_emphasis: Emphasis of Matter: The Company has not made provision for interest on borrowing from a related party since April 1, 2001. As a consequence, loss for the quarter and financial year ended is understated by Rs. 2.87 lakhs & Rs. 11.48 lakhs and aggregate Interest not provided on such Loan up to March 31, 2026 is Rs. 286.68 Lakhs

Emphasis of Matter: Accumulated losses of the Company as at the Balance Sheet date exceeds its paid-up share capital and free reserves and the Company is not carrying on any activity indicating material uncertainty exists casting significant doubt on company's ability to continue as a going concern. The Company has however prepared account on Going Concern Basis based on evaluation of possibilities of restructuring the activities of the Company. Auditor has not received sufficient appropriate evidence to substantiate any such efforts
Company has incurred cash losses of Rs. 27.67 Lakhs in the financial year and in the immediately preceding financial year of Rs. 32.31 Lakhs.
During the year, there was a resignation of the statutory auditors. The outgoing auditors has not expressed any issues, objections, or concerns.
We have not been provided with Internal Auditor's Report.

The Company owes an aggregate amount of Rs. 329.96 Lakhs to companies towards borrowings (inclusive of accrued interest of Rs.226.61 Lakhs), it is unable to discharge this liability due to financial difficulties and lack of funds.

Provision has not been made towards interest payable to the associate companies on their short term borrowings due to the Company having not earned any revenue / income or carried out any business activities during the financial year ended 31-03-2026.
After the closure of the plant at Mulund on 01-12-1995 the remaining facilities have been impaired/ discontinued.

The accumulated losses of the Company as at the Balance Sheet date exceeds its paid up share capital and free reserves eroding its networth and the Liabilities exceeds it assets as on the balance sheet date.
